session_updates.achievement: Tetris Mobile Fall Down Fix Deployed
session_updates.description: Successfully fixed Bug #54 - mobile touch hold-to-drop functionality. Hold-to-drop now only cancels on significant movement (>20px), improved responsiveness with 50ms delay and 30ms interval, achieved cross-platform parity between mobile and desktop.
session_updates.technical_details: Modified handleTouchMove function in tetris-scroll.js to add movement threshold, reduced TETRIS_HOLD_DELAY from 100ms to 50ms, reduced TETRIS_HOLD_INTERVAL from 50ms to 30ms for faster gameplay.
session_updates.impact: MAJOR - Mobile Tetris gameplay now matches desktop functionality, significantly improved mobile user experience

session_updates.description: Identified data display issue in 12.0 Management tab. API authentication fixed for local development, API path validation corrected, tab switching working, but content not displaying in sub-tabs. Root cause needs debugging.
session_updates.technical_details: Fixed API authentication bypass for local development, corrected API_BASE_URL to use http://localhost, fixed path validation in get-12-0-file.php, improved markdown conversion, but content display logic needs debugging.
session_updates.impact: MEDIUM - Admin interface partially functional, 12.0 Management system 80% complete
